title: Tanner McKee set for the first meaningful start of his NFL career with Jalen Hurts out

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tanner McKee set for the first meaningful start of his NFL career with Jalen Hurts out
sources.description: Eagles quarterback Tanner McKee is set to start on Sunday against the Panthers after Jalen Hurts was ruled out with a blood clot.
